briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Colossus v2 escalate AGI timelines as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid US export controls tightening on advanced chips to China. Global AI investment hits record quarterly highs driven by sovereign AI initiatives. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments across autonomous systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with 2.1T parameters achieving new SOTA on agentic benchmarks. Anthropic Claude 4 Opus and Google Gemini 3.0 enter limited preview. DeepSeek releases R2 with open weights while Meta scales Llama 4 to 405B.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with first fines issued for high-risk model non-compliance.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell production ramps to 500K units monthly. Microsoft announces $20B Stargate supercluster expansion in Texas. TSMC 2nm process yields improve for next-gen AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
